title: Privia, Tony Gwynn, and the Death of the VBC Grand Slam
summary_bullets: Privia's 'boring' strategy of maintaining 100+ VBC and 100+ FFS contracts across diverse payors provides resilience as MA market struggles
Focus on actuarial rigor and contract discipline prevents the weak underwriting that led to enabler failures in 2024-2025
Geographic density in specific metro areas matters more than national scale for managing care patterns and outperforming on quality and cost

title: Regard AI Case Study: Sentara Health
existing_summary: AI flagged hyperthyroidism hidden in a primary care note that was causing uncontrolled heart failure, driving 17% jump in CC/MCC capture and up to 4x ROI per user with 74% voluntary hospitalist adoption during pilot.
summary_bullets: Physicians see only 3% of a patient's chart; 97% contains hidden diagnoses in old notes and lab trends
AI caught diagnosis hospitalist 'wouldn't have even known to look for' in patient's medical history
Resulted in significant improvements in coding capture and clinical decision-making adoption rates

title: CJR-X and Health System Capability Requirements
existing_summary: Health systems set up to succeed in CJR-X need proven capabilities in episode management, physician alignment, post-acute optimization, care coordination, and performance analytics.
summary_bullets: Success in CJR-X requires established capabilities across multiple care delivery functions
Navvis has decade-long experience helping systems develop bundled payment program capabilities
Organizations can assess their CJR-X readiness through capability self-assessment
